description: Road Ahead upcoming projects is a dataset listed in City of Vancouver Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Vancouver. This dataset is one of three that provides information on construction activity and projects that may affect the flow of traffic in the City. This dataset describes upcoming projects. The others are for projects currently under construction, and current road closures. All will affect the flow of traffic. Coverage: Vancouver. The portal files it under Streets and transportation. Its keywords are traffic. The portal shows 199 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-vancouver-ca-portal.
